issues.fix: Wider spacing did not fix the outline type. The stroked display glyphs still show internal contour lines from overlapping paths: diagonal strokes inside M and N, a triangle inside D and a stray bar in G and H in MIDNIGHT, and a '$'-like cross-stroke in the outlined B of BASS. Flatten or union the glyph outlines before stroking (or use an outline-safe font or static instance), or switch to a solid fill with an offset outline.

The waves-to-bars match cut lands on an almost empty black frame showing only the 'BASS THEORY' caption, and the bars only rise over the next 2-4 frames. The audio at the cut is also weak (+1.1 dB RMS, compared with +7 to +18 dB at the other world and shot cuts), and 8.73s is off the 120 BPM grid (17.47 beats). Either move the cut to 8.5s or 9.0s or keep 8.73s, but make the straightened wave lines become the bars on the first frame and give the cut a kick and snap.

The opening is bigger, but every element still sits in a band from about y 300 to 1050, leaving the lower ~45% of the frame black for the whole of shot 1. Lower the composition centre, or let the radial EQ or the burst reach past y 1300 on the 2.0s and 2.5s hits.

There are short low-motion pockets (frame MAD below 1.5). None breaks the 1.5s rule, but the 6.73-7.37s pocket in the sun world sits right before the moon cut. Add an on-beat accent at 7.0s, such as the rings stepping or the dot grid pulsing, so the beat is carried into the cut.
The final 0.4s end-card hold is acceptable. Optionally, let the progress-thumb ring or the wave ring do one last beat pulse at 14.5-14.6s so the final frame is not completely static.
